request: Continue important connected histories; owner permits supplied art as atmospheric backgrounds where it fits.
authority: Explicit owner canon and established quest narration/outcomes govern. Character memories, interpretations and proposed actions remain attributed.
scope: All text in three bounded native quest windows was read: 64 dream-rift rows, 104 volcanic rows and 107 coastal rows. The 65th selected dream row is an empty next-session marker and is excluded. Empty/OOC rows, quoted reply duplicates, rules numbers, unviewed attachments and source jokes are not reconstructed as public events. This is not an exhaustive rift archive review.
boundaries: All 392 timeline dates, ratings, regions, event IDs and story destinations survive; only these three people and summary fields change. The early dream posting date remains unresolved against arrival chronology.
Harry’s crushing is explicit. Arjahn’s collapse and Yllandaer’s dying thought are preserved without inventing rescue, resurrection or a complete casualty list.
Dream visions do not independently verify the history they depict. Death’s smile establishes no bargain or universal origin of rifts.
The volcanic crystal collapses after destruction; the finishing attacker or spell is not named. Disintegrate is offered, not witnessed as the final cast.
Volcanic healing is credited to the witnessed recipients, including Ryvyt’s healing of Djöhandrai while calling to Farkur. The banishment ruling belongs to that encounter.
The final volcanic impact has no established destination. Shop and meeting invitations are not completed visits.
Nymera falls and later fights again; no death or resurrection is inferred. Her endurance and Fenwick’s praise do not establish immortality or divinity.
The brief coastal harvesting interval is not assigned an in-world duration; no invented loot, recipe, army origin or coast identity.
Private patron names, controller identities and unrelated jokes are omitted. No generic/unclassified character pages are created.
Ash-plains and jungle-crossing reuse approved atmospheric art; no depicted geography is canonized, and no media bytes or runtime behavior change.

events: A volcanic rift collapses after its crystal is destroyed
A coastal rift opens onto a battle from the sea
